svg.aria-label: Incident triage architecture: eight agents, five connectors, Azure and Azure DevOps
svg.text: the only agents that write anything
the only way agents reach Azure; demo mode swaps it
Eight agents share one run. The Triage supervisor starts three evidence agents in parallel; Diagnosis weighs their findings and can send them back out for more. Agents never call Azure directly: each

evidence agent reads through its own connector, and the one connector that can change a resource (Action) is reachable only after a person approves. In demo mode the connector layer points at Prometheus,
Loki and a fault injector instead of Azure.
